name: Stable Diffusion KMP
tagline: Make pictures from words on your phone
description:
This app turns a written description into an image using Stable Diffusion. It can talk to a server you run at home, to an online image service, or generate on the device itself.

You get all the usual controls — size, steps, negative prompts, image-to-image — plus a gallery of everything you've made, saved locally.
